title: On General Linear Degenerate Elliptic PDE Systems
summary: Let $Ω\Subset \mathbb{R}^{n}$ be a strictly convex bounded domain. Suppose $\mathbf{A} : \mathbb{R}^{Nn} \longrightarrow \mathbb{R}^{Nn}$, $\mathbf{B}: \mathbb{R}^{Nn} \longrightarrow \mathbb{R}^{N}$, $\mathbf{C}: \mathbb{R}^{N} \longrightarrow \mathbb{R}^{N}$ are linear maps, where $\mathbf{A}$ is symmetric and non-negative definite.
